title: Subzeroditto's Moonshine
description: a magic crossbow that uses mirrors to reflect magic bolts
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/tJehOyORTmM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Adds "Moonshine" from this video, sneak to place a mirror, shoot to shoot a hitscan magical bolt that instaly hits, mirrors delay the bolt but home onto the closes entity that doesnt have a "Moonshine" in their hands.

run /function moonshine:give to get and /function moonshine:give_op to get a version with quick charge 5
